figurative_meaning_en: to experience gain or loss (or no significant effect)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এতে আমার কিছু আসে যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: It makes no difference to me if that happens.
There's no gain or loss for him in this deal.
note: Often used in phrases like 'কিছু আসে যায় না' to denote indifference or lack of personal stake.
